title: Recipe Sauce Contract 2.0 Fresh Design -- candidate contract comparison

shapeClass.S1_SINGLE_SUPPORTED: base ∈ {tomato-sauce, pesto, olive-oil}, no other spread layer
shapeClass.S2_SINGLE_NEW_SAUCE: single base outside the current union (e.g. bbq-sauce), no other spread layer
shapeClass.S4_SAUCELESS_BASE_PLUS_LAYER: #189 sauceBase.status == none but >=1 spread layer (mostly olive-oil) -- Q5 base-or-layer question
shapeClass.S6_UNCONFIRMED: sauce base unspecified/unresolved, or an open composition (A/B) / scatter-vs-spread alias item can change the spread set

definitions.confirmed: exactly one sauce shape is consistent with #189 + Evidence Pack open items. Unconfirmed rows are never counted as confirmed; they are reported as all-outcomes / some-outcomes / none.
outcomeEnumeration: unspecified base: family その他 -> {tomato-sauce, pesto, olive-oil, sauceless, NEW}; other families -> {NEW}; each listed spread in the row may instead be the base (LISTED_SPREAD_MAY_BE_BASE)
listed_unresolved base token (ホワイトソース/カレーソース) -> NEW
sauceless row whose only layer is an unresolved token (チーズソース) -> {sauceless, NEW base}
CLASS_MISMATCH_SCATTER_VS_SPREAD alias (唐辛子系) -> {scatter (no spread change), +chili-oil layer}
composition item -> {matrix row shape (PIZZA DB = B), catalog shape (A, catalog 'sauce' field = base, other spread ingredients = additional)}
definitions.q5Reinterpretation: ASSUMPTION, not counted as confirmed: a sauceless row whose only spread is one layer (e.g. vongole: none + olive-oil) is re-read as 'that layer is the base' -- the convention the 3 shipped olive-oil recipes already use.
definitions.wholeRowNoFurtherRuntime: sauce shape confirmed & representable AND every requiredCapability/candidateCapability of the row is covered by the option (B/C/D cover MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER only). Non-runtime evidence blockers (collision, naming, mechanic confirmation of a non-sauce capability) are listed per row but do not change representability.
definitions.idPolicy: REGISTRY: a sauce id is any Ingredient with category 'sauce' (new id = ingredient data authoring only). CLOSED: TS literal union (new id = src type change). A-D are evaluated with REGISTRY; closedUnionVariantSauceConfirmed shows the same option with CLOSED.

BASELINE.label: 現行 contract（単一必須 base, closed union）

A.label: nullable base sauce（base: Layer | null, 追加層なし）

B.label: layers[] model（順序付き 0..n 層, base の役割なし）

C.label: base + optional additional layers（base: Layer | null + layers: Layer[]）

D.label: profile 廃止・recipe data から導出（requiredIngredients の sauce-category 順 + Ingredient 側 interaction）

dependencyMap.singleSauceAssumption: profile has exactly one ingredientId; recipes.ts has no explicit sauce field
dependencyMap.multiLayerToday: not expressible in profile; recipes.ts could list 2 sauce-category requirements but profile/test would reject

migrationComplexity.A: S: 型 nullable 化 + Reference/scoring の null 分岐 + test
migrationComplexity.B: L: reducer/pizzaState/描画/gate/scoring/discovery を N 層化、base 概念を全消費者から除去
migrationComplexity.C: L: B と同じ N 層化 + base を残すので単層消費者は base だけ読めば現状維持
migrationComplexity.D: M〜L: profile ファイル削除・referencePizza/test の読み先変更。多層は B/C と同じ runtime 作業

scoringImpact.A: sauceless 時の Sauce 52 の扱い（再配分 or 固定）が必須決定。単層は byte-identical 可能
scoringImpact.B: 全層を 1 component にまとめるか層ごとか決定必須。base 概念がないので 52 の割当先が曖昧
scoringImpact.C: base は現行 Sauce component をそのまま適用可能。additional 層の配点が新規決定
scoringImpact.D: C と同じ論点。ただし role を持たないので base/additional の区別は配列順規約に依存

uiImpact.A: SAUCE step 省略は既存（cookingProfiles.ts:125）。Reference 表示の null 分岐
uiImpact.B: SAUCE step 内で層切替 UI、層ごと heatmap、Result の層別表示
uiImpact.C: B と同じ。ただし additional 層だけ別 step/別 tray 行にする余地

persistenceImpact.A: なし（pizza/GameState は非永続、新 id は INGREDIENTS から自動）

futureExtensibility.A: 低〜中: 第 2 層・drizzle・post-bake は別 contract が必要
futureExtensibility.B: 中: 層に timing/interaction/zone を持たせられるが base 役割を後付けする必要
futureExtensibility.C: 高: base と additional の役割が明示。layer に timing(PRE/POST_BAKE)・interaction(PAINT/DRIZZLE)・zone を追加できる
futureExtensibility.D: 中: SSOT は 1 つになるが per-recipe の interaction/timing 差を表すには recipe 側に項目追加が必要（= C 相当に戻る）

ownerDecisionItems.question: Contract shape: A / B / C / D (or other)
Sauce id policy: ingredient registry (category 'sauce') vs closed union widened per id
Q5: is olive-oil on a 'none' row (vongole, bianca, p8 salads...) a base or an additional layer? Shipped convention treats olive-oil as base (quattro-formaggi / fugazza / pizza-bianca).
Q5: mayo / honey / blue-cheese-dressing / kebab-sauce / chutney / melted-butter -- base or additional layer, per row (matrixRoleUnconfirmed rows)
Scoring for sauceless recipes: redistribute the 52 Sauce weight, or other policy
Scoring for additional layers: scored / presence-only / unscored
Layer timing: are post-bake drizzles (honey, olive-oil finish, mayo on teriyaki) part of the sauce contract or LATE_ADDITION
Interaction for new sauces: PAINT / PAINT_TEMPORARY only, or introduce DRIZZLE
Family-level sauce ids (curry / white / hot / tare / dessert): one generic id per family or dish-specific ids
Shipped recipes: keep 15 byte-identical, or adopt PIZZA DB side for W0 rows (margherita/marinara +olive-oil, quattro-formaggi/fugazza sauceless)
